{{Quote|Commander Offee -- before you arrived, we had plans for an ambush...|The ARC commander to [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]]|<ref name="Plain Sight" />}}
This [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] '''commander''' served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and was present during the [[Battle of Nadiem]] five months after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="Plain Sight" />

==Armor and equipment==
He wore the standard [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I battle armor]] which was also worn with a blast dampening [[Kama/Legends|''kama'']] and a [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]]. He used an [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A rifle]] during combat, and used [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]] to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] troop movements.<ref name="Plain Sight" />
